name: ann_benchmarks_glove100_prefix
source_layout: HDF5 contiguous little-endian float32, inspected with h5py 3.16.0
selection: first 16384 original train vectors and first 2048 original held-out test vectors; no renormalization or fitted preprocessing
pin_scope: SHA256 pins both selected raw byte ranges and complete prepared arrays. The remaining 478 MB source file is NOT SHA256 verified. ETag is provenance, not a cryptographic hash.
metric: squared Euclidean MSE for clustering; no claim to reproduce ANN-Benchmarks angular retrieval metrics
credit: Jeffrey Pennington, Richard Socher and Christopher D. Manning, GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation (EMNLP 2014); ANN-Benchmarks HDF5 repackaging
